ccsync — синхронизация Claude Code между:
ccsync — sync Claude Code between machines through git.

    ccsync init            create this machine's passport and connect it
    ccsync pull [what]     take what others sent and lay it out here
    ccsync push [what]     send what is here
    ccsync status          what differs (changes nothing)
    ccsync ignore          keep this session out of the vault
    ccsync forget          forget a session everywhere: here and on every machine
    ccsync bind <key>      bind a project to its path on this machine
    ccsync adopt           move local directories into the vault as symlinks
    ccsync machines        list the known machines
    ccsync mcp             MCP servers and the machines they belong to
